title: Annuity Premium Calculation & Guaranteed Minimum Rider Rate Rules
description: As an Annuities Agent, I want the policy portal to calculate the accumulation value, guaranteed minimum interest rate, and GLWB rider fees based on initial premium and applicant age.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: If initial premium >= $10,000 and age >= 50, apply Tier 1 GLWB bonus of 5%.
AC2: GLWB annual rider fee is calculated as 0.95% of contract value.
AC3: Total accumulation value after Year 1 must equal Premium * (1 + GuaranteedRate) - RiderFee + Bonus.
AC4: Output JSON quote must include policyType, guaranteedRate, annualRiderFee, and year1Accumulation.

title: Life & Annuity Policy Issuance Eligibility Rules & Underwriting Guardrails
description: As a Policy Operations Lead, I want the system to evaluate applicant risk factors (age, state availability, suitability score) to issue policy automatically or flag for manual underwriting.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Applicant age must be between 18 and 85 years old.
AC2: State availability must match approved licensed states (IA, TX, FL, CA). NY is restricted.
AC3: Suitability score >= 80 triggers Instant Approval status (APPROVED).
AC4: Replacement policy flag set to true requires mandatory Disclosure Form submission.
